CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resolve_organization_zalo_entitlement_pools(p_organization_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(account_subtype text, entitlement_id bigint, product_id bigint, product_name text, package_name text, package_type text, expiration_date timestamp with time zone, max_sends_per_day integer, max_accounts integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, pool_revision text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
  WITH active_entitlements AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      entitlement.id,
      entitlement.product_id,
      entitlement.product_name,
      entitlement.package_name,
      entitlement.package_type,
      entitlement.expiration_date,
      entitlement.max_accounts,
      entitlement.created_at,
      entitlement.xmin::text AS entitlement_xmin,
      COALESCE(entitlement.is_zalo_show_web, false) AS grants_web,
      COALESCE(entitlement.is_zalo_server, false) AS grants_server,
      CASE
        WHEN entitlement.max_sends_per_day > 0 THEN entitlement.max_sends_per_day
        WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(entitlement.package_type, ''))) = 'demo' THEN 30
        ELSE NULL
      END AS resolved_daily_limit
    FROM public.org_organization_product AS entitlement
    WHERE entitlement.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND entitlement.product_id IN (16, 18)
      AND entitlement.is_deleted = false
      AND entitlement.expiration_date IS NOT NULL
      AND entitlement.expiration_date >= (
        date_trunc('day', timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', now()))
          AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
      )
  ),
  representative AS (
    SELECT entitlement.*
    FROM active_entitlements AS entitlement
    ORDER BY
      entitlement.expiration_date DESC,
      entitlement.created_at DESC NULLS LAST,
      entitlement.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  merged AS (
    SELECT
      count(*) AS entitlement_count,
      count(*) > 0 AS qr_enabled,
      COALESCE(bool_or(entitlement.grants_web), false) AS web_enabled,
      COALESCE(bool_or(entitlement.grants_server), false) AS server_enabled,
      CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0
          OR bool_or(entitlement.resolved_daily_limit IS NULL)
          THEN NULL
        ELSE max(entitlement.resolved_daily_limit)
      END AS max_sends_per_day,
      CASE
        WHEN count(*) = 0
          OR bool_or(
            entitlement.max_accounts IS NULL
              OR entitlement.max_accounts <= 0
          )
          THEN NULL
        ELSE max(entitlement.max_accounts)
      END AS max_accounts,
      md5(COALESCE(
        string_agg(
          entitlement.id::text || ':' || entitlement.entitlement_xmin,
          ',' ORDER BY entitlement.id
        ),
        ''
      )) AS aggregate_revision
    FROM active_entitlements AS entitlement
  ),
  slots(account_subtype, sort_order) AS (
    VALUES
      ('qr'::text, 1),
      ('web'::text, 2),
      ('server'::text, 3)
  )
  SELECT
    slot.account_subtype,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.id END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.product_id END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.product_name END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.package_name END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.package_type END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.expiration_date END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN merged.max_sends_per_day END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN merged.max_accounts END,
    CASE WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN representative.created_at END,
    CASE
      WHEN grant_state.enabled AND merged.entitlement_count = 1 THEN
        representative.id::text || ':' || representative.entitlement_xmin
      WHEN grant_state.enabled THEN
        representative.id::text || ':' || merged.aggregate_revision
      ELSE
        'none:'
          || COALESCE(p_organization_id::text, 'null')
          || ':'
          || slot.account_subtype
    END AS pool_revision
  FROM slots AS slot
  CROSS JOIN merged
  LEFT JOIN representative ON true
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE slot.account_subtype
      WHEN 'qr' THEN merged.qr_enabled
      WHEN 'web' THEN merged.web_enabled
      WHEN 'server' THEN merged.server_enabled
      ELSE false
    END AS enabled
  ) AS grant_state
  ORDER BY slot.sort_order;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_unit_started(p_campaign bigint, p_account bigint, p_unit uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record;
BEGIN
 SELECT runtime_claim_token, runtime_unit_claimed_at, runtime_unit_vietnam_date INTO c
 FROM public.auto_campaigns WHERE id=p_campaign AND account_id=p_account AND runtime_unit_token=p_unit;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE public.auto_account_random_run_days d SET state=jsonb_set(d.state,'{turns}',(
   SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN x->>'claimToken'=c.runtime_claim_token::text AND x->>'status'='running'
     THEN x||jsonb_build_object('unitToken',p_unit,'unitStartedAt',c.runtime_unit_claimed_at) ELSE x END ORDER BY n)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') WITH ORDINALITY AS a(x,n))), updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE d.account_id=p_account AND d.run_date=c.runtime_unit_vietnam_date
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') x WHERE x->>'claimToken'=c.runtime_claim_token::text AND x->>'status'='running');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_claim_allowed(p_campaign bigint, p_account bigint, p_turn text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_account_random_run_days d
   JOIN public.auto_accounts a ON a.id=d.account_id,
   LATERAL (SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') WITH ORDINALITY q(x,n)
     WHERE x->>'status' IN ('planned','running') ORDER BY n LIMIT 1) next_turn
   WHERE d.account_id=p_account AND d.run_date=timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',clock_timestamp())::date
     AND d.status='open' AND next_turn.x->>'status'='planned'
     AND next_turn.x->>'id'=p_turn AND (next_turn.x->>'campaignId')::bigint=p_campaign
     AND (next_turn.x->>'revision')::int=(a.facebook_random_run_config->>'revision')::int
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.campaign_dispatch_schedule_allowed(p_schedule timestamp with time zone, p_source_mode text, p_schedule_end_date timestamp with time zone, p_daily_stop_time time without time zone, p_now timestamp with time zone, p_legacy_cutoff boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_schedule IS NOT NULL AND p_schedule <= p_now
    AND (p_source_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'data_group'
      OR p_schedule_end_date IS NULL OR p_schedule_end_date > p_now)
    AND CASE WHEN p_legacy_cutoff THEN
      -- Preserve the checked/legacy RPC's strict cutoff and nullable stop time.
      -- The v2 wrapper still enforces its inclusive 23:59/day boundary itself.
      p_daily_stop_time IS NULL OR timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', p_now)::time <= p_daily_stop_time
    ELSE
      timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', p_now)::time < least(coalesce(p_daily_stop_time, time '23:59'), time '23:59')
    END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_pause_requested(p_campaign bigint, p_account bigint, p_claim uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_campaigns c JOIN public.auto_account_random_run_days d ON d.account_id=c.account_id AND d.staff_id=c.staff_id,
     jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') x
   WHERE c.id=p_campaign AND c.account_id=p_account AND c.runtime_claim_token=p_claim AND c.note='Đang chờ tạm dừng'
     AND d.status='open' AND x->>'campaignId'=p_campaign::text AND x->>'claimToken'=p_claim::text AND x->>'status'='running'
 )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_unit_settled(p_campaign bigint, p_account bigint, p_unit uuid, p_cancelled boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record; done integer; seconds integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT runtime_unit_input_data_ids ids, runtime_unit_vietnam_date AS unit_day, runtime_unit_claimed_at started
 INTO c FROM public.auto_campaigns WHERE id=p_campaign AND account_id=p_account AND runtime_unit_token=p_unit;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT count(*)::int INTO done FROM public.auto_campaign_input_data i WHERE i.campaign_id=p_campaign AND i.id=ANY(c.ids)
 AND i.status NOT IN ('chờ xử lý','đang chạy');
 seconds:=greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-c.started))::int);
 UPDATE public.auto_account_random_run_days d SET state=jsonb_set(d.state,'{turns}',(
   SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN x->>'unitToken'=p_unit::text AND x->>'status'='running'
     THEN (x-'unitToken'-'unitStartedAt')||jsonb_build_object(
       'processed',(x->>'processed')::int+CASE WHEN x->>'unit'='data' THEN done WHEN p_cancelled THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
       'elapsedSeconds',CASE WHEN x->>'unit'='minute' AND NOT p_cancelled THEN least((x->>'quantity')::bigint*60,seconds) ELSE coalesce((x->>'elapsedSeconds')::int,0) END,
       'lastUnitToken',p_unit) ELSE x END ORDER BY n)
   FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') WITH ORDINALITY a(x,n))),updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE d.account_id=p_account AND d.run_date=c.unit_day AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') x WHERE x->>'unitToken'=p_unit::text AND x->>'status'='running');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_orphan_turns(p_staff bigint, p_org bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, account_id bigint, claim text, unit text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT DISTINCT c.id,c.account_id,x->>'claimToken',x->>'lastUnitToken'
 FROM public.auto_account_random_run_days d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(d.state->'turns') x
 JOIN public.auto_campaigns c ON c.id=(x->>'campaignId')::bigint AND c.account_id=d.account_id AND c.staff_id=d.staff_id
 JOIN public.auto_accounts a ON a.id=c.account_id AND a.staff_id=c.staff_id
 JOIN public.org_staff s ON s.id=c.staff_id AND s.organization_id=p_org
 WHERE d.staff_id=p_staff AND d.organization_id=p_org AND d.status='open' AND x->>'status'='running'
   AND a.flatform_type='facebook' AND (c.organization_id IS NULL OR c.organization_id=p_org) AND (a.organization_id IS NULL OR a.organization_id=p_org)
   AND c.runtime_claim_token IS NULL AND c.runtime_unit_token IS NULL AND c.status<>'đang chạy'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.facebook_random_finalize_on_release()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Only this staff's startup reset defers finalization. The reset restores the
 -- previous transaction-local setting immediately after its campaign update.
 IF current_setting('aka_agent.facebook_random_reset_staff', true) = NEW.staff_id::text THEN
   RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 PERFORM private.facebook_random_finalize_turn(NEW.id,NEW.account_id,OLD.runtime_claim_token,OLD.runtime_unit_token);
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
